capture.coverageClaim: Every 250 m grid cell intersecting the runtime playable mask or exact analytic 600 m ring is included. This describes capture coverage only; it is not a fidelity score.

perfMaxima.note: World-only high-quality top-down captures, moving traffic hidden, mirror excluded. Separate maxima need not occur in one frame; not a driving frame-budget acceptance test.

coverage: Every 250 m grid cell intersecting the runtime playable mask or exact analytic 600 m ring is included. This describes capture coverage only; it is not a fidelity score.
description: Complete source-snapshot survey of the playable area and exact 600 m scenery ring, with four distant corner views.
coverageNote: 99 captured 250 m squares: 22 touch the runtime playable mask, 73 additional squares touch its exact analytic 600 m ring, and four corners are optional distant context. Boundary cells include land beyond the ring.
reviewNote: All 99 fresh game/aerial pairs inspected on 17 local sheets. This records capture coverage and source review; estimated heights, simplified roofs and missing complex structures prevent full fidelity acceptance.

collectionNotes.atlas: Branch source ff708061 · 8 November 2026. High quality, summer, clear daylight; moving traffic and mirrors disabled. Includes source railway scenery and all retained measured crowns. Shared road production changes are excluded.

sourceCaptureManifest.note: Immutable capture ledger; the overview manifest adds labels and live-provider metadata. validation.json hashes refer to this ledger.

aerial.attribution: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
aerial.delivery: Live image request; no aerial reference imagery is stored in this repository.
aerial.extent: 250 m ground square centred at each listed WGS84 coordinate; EPSG:3857 with latitude scale correction.

review.status: All 99 game/aerial pairs inspected across 17 local contact sheets. Only game images are distributed here.
review.purpose: Capture integrity, whole-area coverage and source-led comparison; not visual-parity acceptance.
limitations: This frozen source includes railway scenery and measured crown retention. Later shared road, facade, source-preservation and drone-controller changes are excluded.
95 tiles touch the required core/ring; the other four are explicitly optional context. Portions of boundary tiles beyond 600 m retain limited procedural masses and sparse ground.
1,705 building heights remain default or sanity estimates; strict all-size source identity and unchanged-footprint acceptance await the shared preservation work.
Basarab pylons/cables, CET cooling towers, AFI atrium and compound industrial roof details remain incomplete. Generic facade and vegetation species/height estimates remain visible.
The reference mosaic acquisition date is unknown. OSM tags take priority over older imagery; off-nadir roofs and seasonal vegetation limit registration.
These are square perspective topdowns: 250 m is the ground-plane span, so elevated roofs project larger. Moving traffic and mirrors are excluded from atlas frame counts.
The full official Street View comparison is held for shared road corrections. Panorama metadata coverage is not image-comparison acceptance.
